title: DATA↔FE-001: Query-Ready Serving Views + Dashboard Data Requirements
description: The Data Engineer provides query-ready data, aggregations, and serving views for dashboards, plus documentation of available query interfaces and data-freshness guarantees; the Frontend/Dashboard Engineer provides the dashboard data and query requirements (metrics, granularity, refresh rate) and visualization requirements (aggregation windows, downsampling needs, query patterns required for dashboard performance). Grounded in DATA_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.4 and FRONTEND_DASHBOARD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.2. The authoritative dashboard query-performance SLO (p95/p99) is owned in DATA §6.12 and is not restated here with invented numbers.

serving_views.description: DATA→FE: query-ready views, aggregations, query-interface docs, freshness guarantees.

dashboard_data_requirements.description: FE→DATA: metrics, granularity, refresh rate, aggregation windows, downsampling, query patterns.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine serving-view delivery and dashboard data-requirement alignment is agent-autonomous (data-requirements alignment at planning; serving-view delivery during development; performance review). The binding dashboard query-performance SLO is owned under DATA §6.12 and gates at performance review.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (data-requirements alignment at planning; serving-view delivery during development; performance review; periodic review as new visualization needs emerge)
confirm_conditions: data freshness, granularity, and refresh rate carry explicit units
serving views expose the metrics the dashboard requires, with a documented query interface
aggregation windows / downsampling needs are reconciled against the serving-view aggregations
dashboard query-performance is reconciled against the DATA §6.12 SLO at performance review
reject_conditions: a freshness, granularity, or refresh-rate quantity emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a serving view asserted as meeting the dashboard SLO without the DATA §6.12 query-performance evidence (Honesty Over Polish §10.3)
a breaking serving-view/schema change presented as compatible without versioning
counter_conditions: a requested refresh rate/granularity is infeasible for the underlying store — request an aggregation/downsampling compromise before committing the view
a new metric requires a telemetry field not in the DATA-owned registry — request schema registration before the serving view
